articles.title: Dark web anonymity creates major legal and investigative challenges in India
articles.summary: Accessing the dark web is not illegal in India, but its encrypted anonymity enables crimes like drug trafficking and cyberattacks. articles.title: Injury crisis: New Zealand suffer 5th blow ahead of 1st ODI vs India
articles.summary: New Zealand's preparations for the five-match ODI series against India have taken another hit, with opener Devon Conway ruled out of Wednesday's series opener after suffering a concussion during a training session in Auckland. Conway is the fifth New Zealand player to be sidelined by an injury ahead of the series, adding to an already lengthy list of absentees.

articles.title: Viral video falsely claims India Defence Minister criticized army over border tensions
articles.summary: A viral video falsely attributes statements to India Defence Minister Rajnath Singh regarding India-China border tensions and Indian Army personnel. Fact checkers confirmed the footage is digitally manipulated and actually shows Singh responding to political remarks made by Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge in Patna. Artificial intelligence detection tools flagged both the video and audio as deepfakes.
